Jwt.//SigningKey: Deliberately absent. Startup fails with a clear message until one is supplied out of source control — appsettings.Development.json locally (it is gitignored), the environment or a vault in deployment.

SendGrid.//ApiKey: Deliberately absent, like the signing key. Supply it out of source control — appsettings.Development.json locally (gitignored), the environment or a vault in deployment. Empty is allowed in Development only: reset codes go to the console instead of the reader's inbox. Outside Development, startup fails without it, because a server that cannot send mail cannot reset a password.
SendGrid.//FromAddress: Must be an address on a domain verified in SendGrid, or every message comes back 403.

RateLimit.//: Auth requests allowed per address per window. Raise it for a deployment behind a NAT that many readers share.

Google.//ClientId: The **Web** OAuth client ID, which is the audience a device asks Google to mint its ID token for. Not a secret — the same value ships inside the APK. There is deliberately no client secret: this app verifies ID tokens rather than trading authorization codes, so a secret would be a credential we store and never use. Leave empty to turn Google sign-in off.
